in_marathi.name: Sharvil
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvil is derived from the Sanskrit words 'shar' and 'vilas', which mean 'king' and 'god' respectively. This name is believed to represent the supreme deity Lord Indra, who is the king of the gods in Hindu mythology. It is a powerful and spiritual name that signifies strength, courage, and intelligence.
